---
title: "The ASX-SGX Merger and the National Interest"
date: "2010-12-09"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets", "Foreign Investment"]
---

ASX commissioned Access Economics to produce a [report on why the ASX-SGX merger is in the national interest](http://www.asxgroup.com.au/media/PDFs/20101206_ASX_SGX__AccessReport.pdf "report on why the ASX-SGX merger is in the national interest"). As the report notes, internationally ‘no previously proposed cross-border exchange sector transaction has failed to proceed on the basis of regulatory disallowance.’ But in Australia, as [Jennifer Hewett](http://www.theaustralian.com.au/business/news/political-odds-stacked-against-asx-merger/story-e6frg906-1225956799892 "Jennifer Hewett") has noted, ‘the politics are overwhelmingly stacked against it’.
